source_video: Crystal Palace vs Manchester City (saved transcript)
timestamp_note: Whisper segment timestamps are estimates; verify against the video before editing.
score_note: Hybrid ranking combines event phrase evidence with separate SoccerNet event-alignment labels and human-reviewed highlight labels. Components and final rank are exploratory scores, not calibrated probabilities.

pipeline_stages.speech_to_text: pretrained Faster-Whisper; language auto-detection or user override
pipeline_stages.translation: optional pretrained NLLB translation to English; timestamps retained
pipeline_stages.nlp_preprocessing: project-written Unicode/whitespace cleanup preserving case and punctuation; exclamation/caps features plus negation/hypothetical/retrospective/live-action cues
pipeline_stages.coreference: project-written nearest-mention resolution over verified aliases; resolves only one unique player antecedent and otherwise abstains
pipeline_stages.event_extraction: project-written event rules and event-frame patterns emit action, conservative actor candidate, team candidates, and outcome cues; target remains unresolved; not trained SRL
pipeline_stages.text_representation: project-fitted TF-IDF unigram/bigram features when TF-IDF checkpoint is selected; otherwise hashed word features
pipeline_stages.deep_learning: project-trained TF-IDF/PyTorch MLP with separately supervised eventness, event-family, and human highlight-value heads
pipeline_stages.model_supervision: separate SoccerNet event-alignment labels and human-reviewed highlight labels
pipeline_stages.temporal_selection: score-based nearby-event grouping with peak, candidate density, and preceding 30-second buildup statistics
pipeline_stages.explainability: temporal attention/context mass for the sequence model; TF-IDF feature ablation for the MLP; neither is causal evidence
limitations: Coreference and event-role extraction use conservative dictionary/phrase heuristics, not trained coreference or SRL models
Only fixture team names are auto-read from SoccerNet-style paths; player names require a verified aliases JSON
Excitement labels in the assistant review set are text-only proxies, not judgments of vocal intensity
Assistant text-only annotations are pseudo-labels and are not human ground truth
Event-family head is weak-label trained and remains experimental
No claim of universal accuracy across languages or competitions

event_frame.method: project-written event-frame patterns; arguments are conservative candidates, not trained SRL
